testCommand.description: Optional deterministic pre-gate test command. Since 0.9.49 it runs on the node declared by .node-version in the task worktree (22, 22.13 or 22.13.0, with an optional leading v and trailing .x; found on the host PATH first, then in the usual install directories, within 15 s in total); a declared node that is not installed, or a .node-version that is there but empty, not a version or unreadable (a directory, no permission, a dangling link), fails the gate with rc 127 instead of running on another node. The result is stored in todos.evidence: testRc, testSummary (names the node), testFailures (up to 8 failed test names), testFailureCount.

createTodoInput.description: Create a real todo card in a registered project.

topicId.description: Optional linked topic ID. When omitted or empty the topic is chosen in this order: (1) caller-session: the topic whose Chief session made the call (run.identity.sessionId; the host does not always supply it); (2) caller-tool, since 0.9.45: the topic whose Chief session started a create-todo tool (tool name matching create_utodo / create_todo) within the last 120 seconds according to the host chat.tool.started events, the latest such call when several did; (3) active-run, since 0.9.44: the topic whose Chief session has a run under way according to the host chat events, the latest started when several are running, which is then only a guess; (4) chief-topic: the most recently updated non-archived topic of the account and profile that has a Chief session, in any project (before 0.9.44: only topics of the same project, in sidebar order); (5) unattended: a non-archived topic of the project without a Chief session, created with Autopilot off when none exists. In case (5) a system message starting with 无人值守话题 is stored in that topic and the create_todo tool answers data.topicResolvedBy = unattended. In case (3) with several Chief sessions running the create_todo tool says so in content. In both cases the caller could not be identified: pass topic_id explicitly.

items.description: Todo record. Since 0.9.68 a card the size budget reduced to a stub carries stubbed: true and stubbedFields (names of the detail fields that had content: spec, plan, diffs, buildChat, timeline, evidence, question, fallbackHistory); it keeps id, number, title, kind, phase, gateOwner, gateKind, projectId, topicId, agentId, reviewerId, engine, withPlan, tags, lastError, revision, createdAt, updatedAt, branch, worktreePath, snapshotSha, buildSessionId, reviewSessionId, an evidence object reduced to its numbers, booleans and strings of at most 120 characters, an active question, diffCount (number of diff files) and hasPlan; spec and plan are empty strings and diffs, buildChat, timeline, fallbackHistory empty arrays. get-todo-detail loads the details. Absent on a card that was not reduced.

quotaProviders.description: Configured subscription/balance quota providers with masked credentials and cached readings. lastSnapshot.windows[] lists every vendor window in order (no cap); a window with usageReported=false means the vendor confirmed the period but sent no usage number (usedPct 0 there is not a reading). lastSnapshot.note (optional, absent when unused) states what the vendor reply covers, e.g. that Grok returns one period and excludes local chat usage.

runtime.description: Live Studio runtime, GitHub CLI, and engine diagnostics.

hostMaxTurns.description: agent.max_turns read from $HERMES_HOME (default ~/.hermes) config.yaml, profile config first; bare or quoted integers; 0 when absent or 0. Informational only.

hostTurnBudget.description: Turn cap the host really applies to plugin sessions (since 0.9.70, #84). effective = HERMES_BRIDGE_MAX_TURNS when > 0, else a positive config.yaml agent.max_turns, else the Web UI bridge default 90.

configured.description: Raw config.yaml agent.max_turns ($HERMES_HOME first, quoted integers accepted); omitted when the key is absent or not an integer.

snapshotTrimmed.description: Present and true only when this snapshot was trimmed to stay under the 1,500,000-byte budget (host limit 2,000,000). Storage is never trimmed. Omitted when the full state fits.

snapshotOverflow.description: Present and true only when the board was still above the host's 2,000,000-byte limit after every trimming stage. The snapshot is then a degraded one: settings, concurrency and counts are real, memories is an empty array, uploaded avatars are replaced by stand-ins, agents and projects stay listed (reduced to stubs with stub=true when they are what is too large: agents keep id, name, role; projects keep id, name, monogram, accent), and every topic and todo is a stub marked stub=true that only names it (topics: id, title, archived, updatedAt; todos: id, number, title, phase, gateOwner, gateKind, updatedAt, projectId, topicId) with empty collections for everything else. Stored data is untouched. Omitted otherwise.

overflowBytes.description: Only with snapshotOverflow: size in bytes of the fully trimmed board that could not be returned.

topicsOmitted.description: Number of whole topics left out of this snapshot as the final trimming stage: archived topics first, then the least recently active; the most recently active topic always stays. In a snapshotOverflow snapshot it counts topic stubs that did not fit. Omitted when no topic was left out. Stored topics are never deleted by trimming.

memoriesOmitted.description: Number of memories left out of this snapshot when it was over the size budget; the 100 kept are pinned ones first, then the most recently updated. Omitted when no memory was left out. Stored memories are never deleted by trimming.

todosOmitted.description: Number of todo cards left out of this snapshot. Since 0.9.68 finished (done/closed) and then idle (todo/queued/failed) cards are first reduced to stubs (todos[].stubbed: true; the board lists them and the drawer loads their details with get-todo-detail), and cards are left out only when even the stubs do not fit: oldest first, finished, then idle, and as a last resort confirm and then review cards. Cards that are building, reviewing or merging are never left out or stubbed. The board shows the number under the 已完成 column (还有 N 张卡未加载). In a snapshotOverflow snapshot it counts card stubs that did not fit. Omitted when no card was left out; counts.total and counts.done still describe the full board.

topicContextInput.description: 0.9.43: identify the topic whose Chief session context is read or compressed.

topicContextOutput.description: 0.9.43: what the page needs to show the Chief context capsule and to decide whether slash commands can be sent. Read-only; tokens in use are not part of it (they arrive on the live session as resumed.contextTokens / usage.updated.contextTokens / /context results).

sessionId.description: Chief host session ID; empty when the topic has no Chief session yet.

contextWindow.description: Context window of the session's model in tokens, from the host's GET /api/studio/sessions/context-length; 0 when the host did not answer within 3 s.

model.description: Model of the Chief session as the host reports it; empty when unknown.

provider.description: Provider of the Chief session as the host reports it; empty when unknown.

commandChannel.description: ready = the session source is one the host parses slash commands for (cli/global_agent/workflow/group_chat); unsupported = it is not (e.g. a coding-agent session), commands must not be sent; unknown = the host did not say, the page probes with /context first.

reason.description: Readable Chinese reason when commandChannel is not ready; empty otherwise.

compressionThreshold.description: Share of the context window at which the host compresses automatically (host config compression.threshold, read through GET /api/hermes/config?section=compression). A section without a usable value is 0.5, as the host reads it; clamped to 0.05–0.95. 0.65 when the host config could not be read.

thresholdSource.description: host = compressionThreshold comes from the host config; fallback = the host did not answer within 3 s and 0.65 is used.

compressingSince.description: Unix ms when the current manual compression lock was taken; 0 when none.

beginTopicCompressOutput.description: 0.9.43: the compression lock was taken. Until it ends (record-topic-command with command compress, or until passes) no Chief turn starts for the topic; sends and wakes are queued.

ok.description: Always true; refusals are thrown with a Chinese reason.

since.description: Unix ms the lock was taken.

until.description: Unix ms the lock expires by itself (since + 135000) if the page never reports the outcome.

lockId.description: Random id of this lock (16 hex characters). Only a record-topic-command carrying it releases the lock.

recordTopicCommandInput.description: 0.9.43: outcome of a slash command the page sent over the live Chief session; written into the topic as a system message. A compress/compact outcome with the matching lockId also releases the compression lock. Not called when the page lost the session before the answer (outcome unknown).

command.description: Canonical command name without the slash, e.g. compress, status, context.

outcome.description: completed / failed / timeout (no terminal event within the page's limit, 120 s for compress) / unsupported (the host did not dispatch the command). Defaults from ok when omitted.

message.description: Host message of the session.command event (or the page's reason); stored at most 2000 characters.

beforeTokens.description: Compress only: context tokens before, from the host event.

afterTokens.description: Compress only: context tokens after, from the host event.

compressed.description: Compress only: the host's compressed flag; false means the host found nothing to fold and left the history unchanged. Omitted when the host did not say.

lockId.description: Compress only: the lockId begin-topic-compress returned. The lock is released only when it matches the current lock; omitted (probe failed before any lock) or different (stale tab, late answer) leaves the lock in place. The system message is written either way.

pending.description: Topics still waiting for another pass after this one. 0 when nothing is waiting.

settled.description: Topics for which this pass added a message or cleared a stale running flag.

send-topic-message.description: Send a user message to the Chief session (strictly queued while Chief is busy unless interrupt=true). The message is stored and announced with board.updated (reason topic.message.accepted:<topicId>, or topic.message.queued:<topicId> for a queued follow-up) before engines are probed; the call waits for the launch for at most 800 ms and then returns the current state (topics[].launching is true) while the launch continues. If the Chief cannot be started the message stays with sendError set and topic.message.failed:<topicId> is announced; the call fails with that error only when the failure arrived inside the 800 ms.

cancel-topic-queue-item.description: Withdraw a queued follow-up message before Chief executes it.

promote-topic-queue-item.description: Stop the current Chief run and execute a queued follow-up message immediately. Waits for the launch for at most 800 ms, then returns the current state while the launch continues; a failed launch puts the item back in the queue.

stop-topic-run.description: Abort an in-flight Chief session run.

retry-merge.description: Since 0.9.48. Put a todo whose merge failed back at the merge gate: phase failed -> review (state event RETRY_MERGE), lastError cleared, gateKind merge (deploy for a deploy card), gateOwner recomputed from the settings as they are now (human for a deploy card, a topic without AUTO, a project without autoMergeAfterReview, a configured test gate whose evidence.testRc is not 0, a non-empty evidence.gateSkipped or an open question; chief otherwise). evidence, branch, worktreePath, snapshotSha and diffs are not written. Only for a card in phase failed with gateKind failed whose lastError starts with 合并失败, with a branch and a worktree directory that exists; otherwise it throws, writes the reason on the card timeline and changes nothing else. A missing worktree is never recreated. Does not merge: todo-action approve_merge / merge_build runs every check again. Refused while another write on the same card is running.

todo-action.description: Run a todo lifecycle transition including continue/fresh retries, plan confirm, review, and merge. Since 0.9.49 cancel_build, close and reopen take the per-card write lock like the other actions (a second write on the same card is refused, not queued), and close is refused with 任务正在合并，完成后再操作 while the card is merging. Also since 0.9.49: cancel_build on a card that is done or closed is refused with a Chinese reason and changes nothing (it used to write the card back to todo), close on a done card is refused with a Chinese reason instead of the state machine error, and review writes the card as reviewing before the review run is launched (a launch that fails puts the card back). Instructions to the worker (message_todo, request_changes, answer_question, confirm_plan) answer within about 1500 ms: the same instruction inside 60 s is not dispatched again, one to a busy worker session waits in todo_queue until its turn ends, one refused by the host as already running fails with a readable lastError, and one sent while the card is still starting is refused with a reason.

list_projects.description: List registered Git/GitHub projects and policies.

inspect_project_repo.description: Strictly read-only Git repository inspection (branches, unmerged commits, status, recent log) for Chief.

list_agents.description: List agents, primary/fallback model configs, reasoning efforts, and live engines.

create_todo.description: Create a backlog todo. data.topicId is the topic the card was linked to and data.topicResolvedBy how it was chosen: explicit (topic_id given), caller-session, caller-tool (since 0.9.45: the Chief session that has just started this tool), active-run, chief-topic or unattended. active-run with several Chief sessions running is a guess (the latest started run): content then says 当前有 N 个总管会话在运行，无法确定建卡归属，请显式传 topic_id. unattended means no caller topic and no Chief topic was found: the card sits in a topic without a Chief session, its progress wakes nobody, content says so, and the caller should pass topic_id explicitly.

get_todo_diff.description: Read size-bounded shadow-index worktree diff and test evidence; long lines/files are truncated and giant generated bundles become stats-only entries.

run_review.description: Dispatch a cross-engine independent read-only review. The result is written to todo.evidence.reviewVerdict when the review turn ends: approved, changes_requested (read from the last VERDICT: APPROVED / VERDICT: CHANGES_REQUESTED line of the reviewer's last message, ASCII or full-width colon; since 0.9.52 the rejection line may also be written VERDICT: CHANGES REQUESTED or VERDICT: CHANGES-REQUESTED), and since 0.9.49 inconclusive (the turn ended without a VERDICT line, its last VERDICT line names both verdicts, or it ends with VERDICT: APPROVED while a VERDICT: CHANGES_REQUESTED line is also in the message; the reviewer is first asked once for it in the same session, evidence.reviewInconclusiveRetries counts that request and is reset to 0 by every review and build dispatch) or review_failed (the review run failed). inconclusive and review_failed park the card at phase review with gateOwner human and gateKind review_inconclusive / review_failed; they are not a rejection, no rework is due and the Chief is not run for them: call run_review again or leave the decision to the user.

ask_user.description: Post a structured question card and park at human gate.

confirm_plan.description: Approve a plan and start implementation. Same rules as message_todo: data.queued when the worker session is busy, data.duplicate for a repeat inside 60 s, data.starting when the launch continues in the background.

message_todo.description: Send follow-up context to a todo worker. Waits for the host to accept the worker run for at most 1500 ms; after that it answers with data.accepted=true and data.starting=true while the launch continues, and the outcome is written to the card timeline. data.queued=true: the worker session was busy and the message waits in todo_queue until its turn ends (no run sent). data.duplicate=true: the same message was accepted less than 60 s ago and was not sent again.

merge_build.description: Merge a todo parked at the review gate into the project base branch. Refused unless topic AUTO, project autoMergeAfterReview, an APPROVED review of the current build, a passing test gate, and no deploy redline.

retry_merge.description: Since 0.9.48. Put a todo whose merge failed back at the merge gate, keeping its review verdict, branch and worktree. Only for a card that stopped in failed because its merge failed (lastError starts with 合并失败); a build failure or an idle round is refused (ok=false, error RETRY_MERGE_REFUSED). Does not merge: call merge_build afterwards, which checks everything again. Input todo_id. data: id, phase, gateOwner, reviewVerdict.

watch_todos.description: Watch a todo from a Chief topic.

cancel_build.description: Stop an active build/review session (discard: also remove the worktree and branch). Since 0.9.49 it takes the per-card write lock (refused while another write runs on the card) and is refused with 任务正在合并，完成后再操作 while a merge runs on the card, or with discard on any card in phase merging. A card in phase done or closed is refused too (nothing runs on it), with or without discard, and is not changed.

rename_topic.description: Concise automatic or requested rename of a Chief topic.

update_topic_brief.description: Update a topic's pinned Brief card (goal, progress, next, waiting_on_you, blocked).

get_system_config.description: Inspect complete Chief, Charter, Agent, Project, Memory, and Runtime configuration.

configure_chief.description: Update Chief binding, primary/fallback models, reasoning effort, Charter, memory flag, or concurrency.

configure_agent.description: Create or update any Agent's primary/fallback model chain, failover switch, reasoning effort, sandbox, approval, and memory config.

configure_project.description: Update an existing project's GitHub binding, test gate, assigned agents, or autopilot policy.

import_github_project.description: Import a GitHub repository via local link or clone and register as a project.

list_memories.description: List persistent Chief, Project, or Agent memories.

manage_memory.description: Create, update, pin, toggle, or delete a persistent memory entry.

list_schedules.description: List configured recurring and one-shot task schedules with next run time and last outcome.

create_schedule.description: Create a recurring (hourly/daily/weekly) or one-shot schedule for a Todo.

update_schedule.description: Update an existing schedule's cadence, time, agent override, or enable state.

reconcile.description: Reconcile active Chief, build, and review sessions and trigger idempotent wakes. Since 0.9.49 a review turn found finished without a VERDICT line is not settled as a rejection: the reviewer is asked once for the verdict in the same session, then the card parks at a human gate (gateKind review_inconclusive).

settle.description: Follow-up syncs after a Chief turn ends: first pass about 1s after the turn was seen finished, then up to 3 retries about 2s apart, until a pass adds nothing and the host message tail stopped changing. Repeatable without duplicates (one row per host message id). A successful pass clears the topic's isRunning and activeRunId unless a new turn has started.

board.updated.description: Broadcast state updates to all mounted Ekko ToDo views.
